text: Patients whose plasma-paracetamol concentrations are above the normal treatment line should be treated. 5. Patients on enzyme-inducing drugs or with malnutrition or a history of alcohol abuse should be treated if their plasma-paracetamol concentrations are above the high-risk treatment line. 6.
